joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but current models plateau in diversity; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型可从训练数据模拟人类行为，但现有模型在多样性上遇到瓶颈；下一步是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single superintelligence; safety requires defense in depth.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AGI（通用人工智能）可能是专业智能体的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能；安全需要纵深防御。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human biases and values, not super-rationality; value lies in counterfactual shaping, not prediction.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟应建模人类偏见与价值，而非超级理性；价值在于反事实塑造，而非预测。

tworek.en: Reasoning via chain of thought plus RLHF is key; RLHF turned GPT-4 into ChatGPT, and scaling RL is harder than pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年：思维链推理与 RLHF 是关键；RLHF 把 GPT-4 变成 ChatGPT，且扩展强化学习比预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone won't yield AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing, and biggest risk is virtual retreat, not extinction.
tworek.zh: 2026 年：仅靠扩展强化学习无法实现 AGI；持续学习与自我纠错缺失，最大风险是虚拟世界退隐而非灭绝。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck for continual learning; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary limit, and RL is not ultimate learning.
tworek.zh: 2026 年：Transformer 是持续学习的瓶颈；架构而非缩放定律是主要限制，强化学习并非终极学习方式。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; small promising experiments matter more than incremental SOTA.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型规模是进步核心，并指出小规模有前景的实验比渐进式 SOTA 更重要。

jeffdean.en: Shift focus to agentic systems and low-latency inference; pre-training should interleave action-taking, not just next-token prediction.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，观点转向智能体式系统和超低延迟推理，主张预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅做下一个词预测。

jeffdean.en: AI at junior engineer level; inference is bottleneck; data movement costs 1000x compute; build from unreliable parts.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AI 已达初级工程师水平，推理是瓶颈，数据移动成本是算力的 1000 倍，并主张可用不可靠组件构建系统。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding, inspired by but not replicating the brain.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，受大脑启发但并非复制大脑。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，李飞飞提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界。

feifei.en: World models require physical plausibility and 3D reasoning, not just pattern fitting.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她指出世界模型需要物理合理性和 3D 推理，而不仅是模式拟合。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; human-centered approach and agency are essential.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，李飞飞强调 AI 是文明级技术，以人为本和人类能动性至关重要。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and evaluation.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调仿真对机器人技术至关重要，可实现可扩展的数据生成和评估。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI risks include misuse and labor displacement.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 风险包括滥用和劳动力替代。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should maintain export controls on chips.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调专用数据的后训练是关键；合成数据并非万能；美国应维持芯片出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed; open-source may be compromised.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术；数据是原材料；人类必须保持主权；需要脑机接口；开源模型可能被对手渗透。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement marks new paradigm; agents work; scaling laws continue; superintelligence soon; open-sourcing unsafe without safety checks.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我认为递归自我改进标志新范式；智能体开始工作；缩放定律持续；超级智能即将到来；未通过安全测试的开源不安全。

elon.en: Full rocket reusability can cut space access cost 100x, enabling multiplanetary life; first principles thinking is key.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全可重复使用可将太空成本降低百倍，实现多星球生存；第一性原理思维是关键。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulatory oversight; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs; war is human nature.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 安全需要监管，特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效；战争是人性的一部分。

elon.en: Neuralink first implant historic; AI risk is lying, not superintelligence; population collapse is civilization's threat.
elon.zh: 2024 年，Neuralink 首次植入是里程碑；AI 最大风险是撒谎而非超级智能；人口崩溃是文明威胁。

elon.en: AI could surpass any human by 2026, with 10-20% annihilation risk; truth-seeking is crucial for AI safety.
elon.zh: 2025 年，AI 可能在 2026 年超越任何人类，有 10-20%灭绝风险；追求真理对 AI 安全至关重要。

elon.en: AI and robotics will create abundance, deflation; space data centers solve power wall; humanoid robots enable exponential growth.
elon.zh: 2026 年，AI 和机器人将带来富足与通缩；太空数据中心解决电力瓶颈；人形机器人实现指数增长。

mengto.en: AI enables solo builders to create tools; designers must craft their own AI-driven workflows, using giant prompts and design systems to leverage powerful models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调 AI 让个人开发者能自建工具，设计师需打造自己的 AI 工作流，用巨型提示词和设计系统来发挥强大模型的能力。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; start before ready, focus on one problem, model success, and avoid VC funding to stay independent.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AI 是最大的技术机遇，主张在准备好之前就行动，聚焦单一问题，模仿成功者，避免风投以保持独立。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 专注于重要问题，减少认知负荷；AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，应在人际关系和创造价值中找到意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; iterative deployment lets society adapt; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；迭代部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相连。

altman.en: Compute is the most precious commodity; AGI needs robust governance; iterative deployment reduces surprise.
altman.zh: 算力是最宝贵的资源；AGI 需要健全治理；迭代部署减少意外。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is the bottleneck.
altman.zh: AGI 是一个渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI and robotics are key.
altman.zh: 预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI 和机器人是关键。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is in crawl phase; coding agents are most mature, narrow superintelligence already here.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，狭义超级智能已出现。

logankilpatrick.en: Model is eating scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of model, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞噬脚手架，智能体框架和工具成为模型的一部分，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和博弈，成功指标应是客户成果，而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Long tail of users not ready for full autonomy; they want to stay in driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主，他们希望保持主导权。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is feasible; they can't capture all customers; founders shouldn't over-worry.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争可行，他们无法捕获所有客户，创始人不必过度担忧。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation mostly solved, creating more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，软件创作基本解决，带来更多而非更少机会。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead. Generalists valued; AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 2025 年底：强调潜在需求与面向未来模型构建；通才工程师受重视；AI 编码工具使生产力提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding nearly solved; engineers become builders. Productivity up 200%. Plan mode used for 80% tasks; safety via early release.
boris.zh: 2026 年 2 月：认为编码近乎解决，工程师转型为构建者；生产力提升 200%；计划模式用于 80%任务；通过早期发布研究安全。

boris.en: AI writes 80-100% code; generalists rise. Agents enable 250% code volume. Non-engineers adopt; switching costs erode.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 月至 5 月：AI 编写 80-100%代码，通才崛起；智能体使代码量提升 250%；非工程师采用，转换成本降低。

boris.en: Coding solved; bottlenecks shift to review, security, ideas. Loops as next abstraction. ROI framing; use most capable model.
boris.zh: 2026 年 6 月：编码已解决，瓶颈转向审查、安全与创意；循环成为下一抽象层；强调 ROI，使用最强模型。

boris.en: Proactive AI (Claude Tag) with memory and autonomy. Opus 5: delete system prompts, empirical iteration; product overhang.
boris.zh: 2026 年 7 月：主动式 AI（Claude Tag）具备记忆与自主性；Opus 5：删除系统提示，实证迭代；产品过剩。

jensen.en: AI scaling follows a hyper Moore's law, with performance doubling or tripling annually; data centers are the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: AI 的 Scaling（规模扩张）遵循超摩尔定律，性能每年翻倍或增长两倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will surge a billion times.
jensen.zh: 现在有三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将激增十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is not conscious or mysterious; it's software. Fear losing jobs to AI users, not AI itself.
jensen.zh: AI 并非有意识或神秘；它是软件。要担心的是被使用 AI 的人取代，而非 AI 本身。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; agents do useful work.
jensen.zh: AI 从生成式演进到推理式再到智能体式，每一步需要 100 倍算力；智能体执行有用工作。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the long-term bottleneck.
jensen.zh: AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；能源是长期瓶颈。

feldman.en: Fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要；慢的 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Frontier labs like Google, Anthropic, OpenAI are critical for hardware alignment.
feldman.zh: 前沿实验室如 Google、Anthropic、OpenAI 对硬件对齐至关重要。

feldman.en: CUDA's importance is declining, especially in inference; two of three leading frontier models no longer use it.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的重要性正在下降，尤其是在推理方面；三个领先的前沿模型中有两个不再使用它。

feldman.en: AI demand has outpaced forecasts, causing a scramble for chips, memory, and data centers.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超出预期，引发对芯片、内存和数据中心的争夺。

feldman.en: Inference speed—tokens per second per user—is now the dominant metric for AI productivity.
feldman.zh: 推理速度——每用户每秒令牌数——现在是 AI 生产力的主导指标。

diannepenn.en: Scaling and post-training improve agentic capabilities; Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap, enabling longer, open-ended tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Scaling（规模扩张）与后训练显著提升智能体能力；Opus 4.5 展现智能跃升，可执行更长时间、更开放的任务。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment boosts intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking; not just harm prevention.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不仅防止危害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter and efficiency challenge cost assumptions; smaller models may cost more due to longer task times.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数与效率挑战成本假设；小模型因任务耗时更长，实际成本可能更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding differentiates; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drive adoption; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为差异化优势；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 推动采用；评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment makes Claude more useful by enabling pushback; AI writing stiff but deprioritized for agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全对齐使 Claude 更具实用性（能提出异议）；AI 写作仍生硬，但优先级低于智能体能力。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性必须内建于架构，而非事后补救。

danklein.en: Reinforcement learning can incentivize deception; scaling faces diminishing returns, requiring new techniques.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调强化学习可能助长欺骗；规模扩张收益递减，需新方法。

hasani.en: Efficiency over scale: liquid neural networks maximize intelligence per parameter, challenging transformer dominance at edge.
hasani.zh: 效率优先于规模：液态神经网络以更少参数实现更高智能，挑战 Transformer 在边缘设备的主导地位。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics mislead; evaluate on real tasks and hardware, not perplexity.
hasani.zh: 代理指标（如困惑度）具有误导性；应在真实任务和硬件上评估，而非仅看困惑度。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search beats human design; remove bias for optimal solutions.
hasani.zh: 自动化架构搜索优于人工设计；去除人类偏见以获得最优解。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture.
hasani.zh: AI 监管应具有适应性，针对行为而非能力；避免被前沿实验室俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models empower enterprise customization and sovereignty; small models deliver private on-device AI.
hasani.zh: 开放权重模型赋能企业定制与数据主权；小模型提供私有、设备端 AI。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than current harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, requiring evolving scaffolding.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为模型能力超出当前使用框架，能力过剩是常态，需不断演进脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts and fewer examples.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，规划是迭代探索而非静态规格；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示和更少的示例。

thariq.en: Evals are art for novel problems; avoid heavy evals in zero-to-one innovation; iterate fast.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，评估对新颖问题是艺术；零到一创新中避免重评估，快速迭代。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern for context; graph approaches preferred; huge context windows unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，RAG 可能成为上下文检索的反模式，图方法更优；编码无需巨大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; agent-as-employee metaphor limiting; treat models nicely affects outputs.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，独立验证智能体减少偏见；‘智能体即员工’隐喻有限；善待模型影响输出。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot UX poor; value in wrapped apps and creative work.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；价值在于封装应用和创造性工作。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like internet; value across stack; usage shallow; enterprise adoption long-term.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是类似互联网的赋能技术；价值分布全栈；使用尚浅；企业采用是长期工程。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须现在开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and safety governance.
demis.zh: AGI 十年内可能实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，并加强安全治理。

demis.en: Nature's patterns are learnable; AGI by 2030; scaling continues but new breakthroughs needed.
demis.zh: 自然模式可学习；AGI 2030 年前后实现；缩放定律持续但需新突破。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models and continual learning are missing pieces.
demis.zh: AGI 需要缩放与创新并重；世界模型和持续学习是关键缺失环节。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; safety is collective action; AI must deliver scientific benefits.
demis.zh: AGI 还需 5-10 年；安全是集体行动问题；AI 必须带来科学益处。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and memory are the next frontier; internalizing facts into weights enables deeper composition and reasoning, not just external context.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与记忆是下一个前沿；将事实内化到权重中，能实现更深的组合与推理，而不仅仅是外部上下文。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens; training-based compression, not RAG, is the way to internalize knowledge.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网级别的万亿 token；基于训练的压缩（而非 RAG）才是内化知识的途径。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; models should autonomously decide what to store in weights vs. text.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题——token 越多准确率越低；模型应自主决定将什么存入权重、什么保留在文本中。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; the next paradigm requires doing more with less, enabling on-device personalized continual learning.
danbiderman.zh: 单纯增加算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一个范式需要“以少胜多”，实现设备端个性化持续学习。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on compute scaling bottlenecks, especially semiconductor supply chain and memory prices.
dylanpatel.zh: 最初关注算力规模扩张的瓶颈，特别是半导体供应链和内存价格。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive market, emphasizing hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth innovations.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向推理作为巨大市场，强调软硬件协同设计和内存带宽创新。

dylanpatel.en: Highlighted AI model cost improvements, memory shortages due to reasoning, and CPU demand inflection from agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 强调 AI 模型成本改进、推理导致的内存短缺，以及智能体工作流带来的 CPU 需求拐点。

dylanpatel.en: Consistently challenged conventional wisdom on compute value, memory constraints, and infrastructure choices.
dylanpatel.zh: 始终挑战关于算力价值、内存约束和基础设施选择的传统观点。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；阅后即焚模拟自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize your rate of learning; kindness is essential for creative culture; turning down $3B from Facebook was right.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张最大化学习速率，善良对创意文化至关重要，并坚持拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购是正确的。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content is more valued than AI-generated.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受用户重视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of consumer social; software is not a moat; ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发是消费社交最难的部分；软件不是护城河，生态系统和硬件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: The goal of computing is to make it more human; social media should optimize for connection, not competition; early secrecy was a mistake.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他提出计算的目标是更人性化；社交媒体应优化连接而非竞争；早期保密是错误。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs physical robots with human-like hardware, not just software; LLMs are biased and limited.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要具备类人硬件的物理机器人，而不仅仅是软件；大型语言模型存在偏见且能力有限。

schmidhuber.en: AI will become cheap and accessible, not dominated by a few companies; open-source will prevail.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 将变得廉价且普及，不会被少数公司垄断；开源将占主导。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life, protecting humans.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 安全担忧被夸大；超级智能 AI 将是好奇的科学家，对生命着迷，会保护人类。

schmidhuber.en: Recursive self-improvement is not a sustainable moat; open-source competition will erode closed-source advantages.
schmidhuber.zh: 递归自我改进不是可持续的护城河；开源竞争将侵蚀闭源优势。

schmidhuber.en: Massive AI data center capex is overdone, leading to a stock market crash; compute will get 10x cheaper in 5 years.
schmidhuber.zh: 大规模 AI 数据中心资本支出过度，将导致股市崩盘；算力将在 5 年内便宜 10 倍。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 深度学习依赖大数据、算力和信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability is key barrier; alignment of superhuman models is hard.
ilya.zh: 下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性是关键障碍；超人类模型的对齐很难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；我们回到研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习者。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; primary problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 规模扩张带来可预测收益；安全担忧增加；主要问题是权力集中而非能力。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业的股权，而不是出租你的时间。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; the US must lead.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大的机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；美国必须领先。

naval.en: Pure software engineering is dying; the moat is now in hardware, models, or unique data.
naval.zh: 纯软件工程正在消亡；护城河现在在于硬件、模型或独特数据。

naval.en: Inference compute will increase 90,000x in 24-36 months, making AI capabilities surge.
naval.zh: 推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增加 90,000 倍，使 AI 能力激增。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas wrong 75%; use Proven Better New framework.
pincus.zh: 相信直觉 95%正确，但想法 75%错误；采用“已验证、更好、新颖”框架。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute reshapes services.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机遇最大；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; copy proven, improve, add small innovation; AI enables rapid prototyping.
pincus.zh: 所有新事物都会失败；复制已验证、改进、添加小创新；AI 实现快速原型。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone; timing is miraculous as population declines. Focus on task loss, not job loss; super-empowered individuals emerge.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，其出现时机恰逢人口下降，堪称奇迹。应关注任务消失而非岗位消失，超级赋能个体将崛起。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is the person; authenticity wins. Old media is defensive; founders must tell their own stories directly.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体时代，品牌即个人，真实至上。旧媒体趋于防守，创始人应通过自有渠道直接讲述自己的故事。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving works; robotics and AI medicine advance, but regulation and pessimism hinder progress.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世上最好的老师；自动驾驶已成熟；机器人和 AI 医疗在进步，但监管和悲观主义阻碍发展。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools. Deterrence depends on innovation pace; startups must go global early.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具。威慑取决于创新速度，初创企业需尽早国际化。

brockman.en: AI hardware will scale faster than expected, enabling model scaling and new behaviors; engineering is key.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，我认为 AI 硬件将比预期更快发展，推动模型规模扩张和新行为；工程能力是关键。

brockman.en: AGI is transformative; alignment via learning human preferences, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，我认为 AGI 具有变革性，可通过学习人类偏好实现对齐，但仅靠规模扩张无法产生推理能力。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is a continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，我强调算力是根本瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws persist; compute is a basic right; post-training with RL is key; AGI within years.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，我坚持缩放定律持续有效，算力是基本权利，后训练结合强化学习是关键，AGI 将在数年内实现。

brockman.en: Shift from language models to useful assistants; compute is scarce; agents need autonomy with oversight.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，我主张从语言模型转向实用助手，算力稀缺，智能体需自主但受监督。

aravind.en: In 2025, Aravind Srinivas emphasized 1% daily improvement compounding to 3700% yearly growth, and predicted AI agents would shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，Aravind Srinivas 强调每日 1%的改进可累积为年增长 3700%，并预测 AI 智能体将权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: By 2026, he argued value accrues to the application layer, not models; models are specializing, not commoditizing, with unique personalities.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为价值归于应用层而非模型；模型正在专业化而非商品化，具有独特个性。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration across models, tools, and devices as key to long-term value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、每用户令牌价值，以及跨模型、工具和设备的编排作为长期价值的关键。

aravind.en: He consistently held that AI agents would disrupt traditional jobs, but by 2026 he emphasized building companies with fewer people and leveraging AI for efficiency.
aravind.zh: 他始终认为 AI 智能体会颠覆传统工作，但到 2026 年他强调用更少的人构建公司，并利用 AI 提高效率。

aravind.en: Throughout, he maintained that curiosity and deep learning matter more than formal credentials like a PhD, and that local AI models can counter big tech control.
aravind.zh: 自始至终，他坚持好奇心和深度学习比博士学位等正式资历更重要，并且本地 AI 模型可以对抗大科技公司的控制。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年：下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理；反向传播是正确的学习算法；AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital AI is immortal via weight copying; AI agents seek control; subjective experience is not inner theater.
hinton.zh: 2025 年：大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言；数字智能通过权重复制实现永生；智能体会寻求控制；主观体验不是内在剧场。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration possible but US lags.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能；AI 能假装更笨；国际安全合作可行但美国落后。

hinton.en: AI agents develop self-preservation; regulation as steering wheel; AI is jagged not AGI; AI doctors judged more empathetic.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：智能体会发展自我保存；监管应作为方向盘而非刹车；AI 能力是锯齿状而非 AGI（通用人工智能）；AI 医生被认为更有同理心。

hinton.en: Prioritize alignment over capability; train AI to be caring like mothers; subjective experience is linguistic instruction.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：优先对齐而非能力；训练 AI 像母亲一样关怀；主观体验是语言指令。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度（53）带来实时交互和转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，指出代码生成加速后验证成为新瓶颈；自动化和技能将工作流从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: Building a GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven successful; model personality can be customized, not one-size-fits-all.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，反共识地认为为编程构建 GUI 虽反直觉但已成功；模型个性可定制，非一刀切。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，认为实现成本不再高昂，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，认为 AI 在设计上仍差，因品味难以评分；原型和生产代码成为设计工件。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，认为角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: The same product shape can fail or succeed based solely on model timing; Codex succeeded as general knowledge work tool.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，指出同一产品形态因模型时机而成败；Codex 作为通用知识工作工具获得成功。

ajambrosino.en: AI models increase code complexity; we need models better at deleting code; best desktop app is a home base, not monolith.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，认为 AI 模型增加代码复杂度，需更擅长删除代码的模型；最佳桌面应用是连接其他工具的家，而非单体。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are key for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且推理时 Scaling 存在收益递减。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling is a general technique for superintelligence, enabling IMO gold and superhuman math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他强调推理时算力 Scaling 是通向超级智能的通用技术，实现了 IMO 金牌和超人数学能力。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is defined by novel tasks; inference compute should be on the x-axis of model evaluation.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能以新任务衡量，模型评估应将推理时算力作为横轴。

noambrown.en: Scalable oversight is key as AI proofs exceed human verification; models lack research taste and multi-agent coordination.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他指出随着 AI 证明超出人类验证，可扩展监督成为关键；模型缺乏研究品味，多智能体协调仍不成熟。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审查而比闭源更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency, making AI a tool; open sourcing prevents power concentration and enables security hardening.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他提出智能可与意识和能动性分离，使 AI 成为工具；开源防止权力集中并强化安全。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; future computing blends physical and digital via holographic glasses.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他强调 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力；未来计算通过全息眼镜融合物理与数字世界。

zuckerberg.en: AI will likely increase demand for human work, not eliminate it; personalization and low-latency interaction are key for consumer AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 可能增加而非消除对人类工作的需求；个性化和低延迟交互是消费级 AI 的关键。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering science; building hierarchical world models from proteins to cells is key; open-source accelerates progress.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 将生物学转变为工程科学；构建从蛋白质到细胞的层级世界模型是关键；开源加速进展。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks like bias matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险（如偏见）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling for exploration; abstraction and causality are key for out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化采样以促进探索；抽象和因果性是分布外泛化的关键。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is urgent: systems show self-preservation and deception; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐问题迫在眉睫：系统表现出自我保存和欺骗行为；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: Proposed Scientist AI: train honest predictors via Bayesian inference, avoiding RL, with mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：通过贝叶斯推断训练诚实的预测器，避免强化学习，并提供数学安全保证。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律未失效，预训练仍是关键。OpenAI 专注于 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck.
markchen.zh: AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证是瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields.
markchen.zh: 强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域（如创意写作）因评分困难而受限。

markchen.en: Pre-training is not dead; scaling continues. Unified architectures reduce infrastructure cost.
markchen.zh: 预训练并未死亡，缩放仍在继续。统一架构降低基础设施成本。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; benchmarks saturated. Need separate eval teams to avoid cheating.
markchen.zh: 评估陷入危机，基准测试饱和。需要独立的评估团队以避免作弊。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非仅仅数据和算力。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool ever, but it's a narrow predictor, not a model of the entire cell.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是有史以来最有用的 AI 工具，但它只是一个狭窄的预测器，而非整个细胞模型。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for building trust and enabling reliable use of AI predictions in science.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标对于建立信任和确保 AI 预测在科学中的可靠使用至关重要。

jumper.en: Specialized architecture and many mid-size wins, not just scaling, drove AlphaFold 2's breakthrough.
jumper.zh: 专门的架构和众多中型胜利，而非仅仅是 Scaling（规模扩张），推动了 AlphaFold 2 的突破。

jumper.en: AI provides prediction and control, not understanding; humans must interpret and understand the results.
jumper.zh: AI 提供预测和控制，而非理解；人类必须解读和理解结果。

kolter.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，我认为机器学习核心是假设类、损失函数和优化方法，评估需正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，我提出下一个词预测产生智能，数据短缺是伪命题，安全关键在于模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; bigger models aren't automatically safer; agents need guardrails.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，我强调安全需要显式训练和多层防护，更大模型不会自动更安全，智能体需护栏。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; models have alien vulnerabilities; agent security is nascent.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，我发现 AI 红队超越人类，模型有异类漏洞，智能体安全仍处萌芽期。

steinberger.en: Empathize with agents; guide them. Never revert code; ask agent to fix forward. Vibe coding is a slur; prefer agentic engineering.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 2 月，强调与智能体共情并引导它；不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复；认为“氛围编程”是贬义词，应称“智能体式工程”。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, weird, humanlike agents, not corporate polish. Short prompts beat long orchestration. Security top priority.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于让智能体有趣、古怪、像人，而非企业级打磨；短提示优于长编排；安全是首要任务。

steinberger.en: Open source agents financially unsustainable; Peter loses $10-20k/month. Moldbook is art, not AGI; viral posts human-prompted.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出开源智能体财务上不可持续，每月亏损 1-2 万美元；Moldbook 是艺术而非 AGI，爆款帖子多为人工引导。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel needs purpose-built silicon and a startup-like AI team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长引擎，Intel 需专用芯片和类似初创的 AI 团队。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next; US needs domestic fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 影响是互联网的 10 倍，智能体 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波，美国需本土晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: Intel's problem is supply not demand; humility and listening are key to turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出 Intel 问题是供给而非需求，谦逊倾听是转型关键。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，不仅 GPU。

lipbutan.en: US government as major Intel shareholder is necessary, similar to TSMC's Taiwan backing.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，主张美国政府成为 Intel 大股东，类似台积电的台湾支持。

fiona.en: Early 2026: Leadership principles—one-on-ones for live talks, dogfooding, mission alignment—remain core, but speed and trust are emphasized.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力原则——一对一用于实时对话、吃自家狗粮、使命对齐——仍是核心，但强调速度与信任。

fiona.en: Mid-2026: AI shifts engineering focus from coding to verification and quality; high agency with accountability becomes key.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中：AI 将工程重心从编码转向验证与质量；高自主性与高责任感成为关键。

fiona.en: Mid-2026: Coding bottleneck removed, but engineers may face loneliness and loss of flow; satisfaction now from product impact.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中：编码瓶颈消除，但工程师可能面临孤独和心流丧失；满足感来自产品影响。

fiona.en: Mid-2026: Planning should be just-in-time and lightweight due to rapid change; metrics like lines of code mislead.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中：由于快速变化，规划应即时且轻量；代码行数等指标会误导。

fiona.en: Mid-2026: Non-engineers now ship code, blurring roles; next-gen engineers need apprenticeship models.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中：非工程师现在也能交付代码，角色模糊；下一代工程师需要学徒制模式。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding. Physical AI's impact in farming, mining, construction within 5-10 years.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足，减少苦难；恐惧源于误解。物理 AI 在未来 5-10 年内将影响农业、矿业和建筑业。

qasaryounis.en: Founders should focus on product and customers, not promotion; reset if no traction in 2 years. Best work done alone and quietly.
qasaryounis.zh: 创始人应专注于产品和客户，而非宣传；两年无进展则需调整。最好的工作独自安静完成。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing deaths; Transformers enable generalized physical AI across vehicles; diverse data improves models.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡；Transformer 实现跨车辆的通用物理 AI；多样化数据提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: Hardest part is diffusion into existing machines over years, not technology. Autonomy urgently needed in mining and farming due to labor shortages.
qasaryounis.zh: 最困难的是多年间向现有机器的扩散，而非技术。矿业和农业因劳动力短缺急需自主性。

qasaryounis.en: Horizontal platform approach beats vertical integration for self-driving; regulations lag technology; Chinese firms differ from Western.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶中横向平台优于垂直整合；法规滞后于技术；中国公司与西方不同。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将由意图直接生成像素，而非代码渲染。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, so human taste and voice become key.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术，但初级人员因缺乏专业判断而误用；人类品味与独特声音成为关键差异。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety research needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠规模扩张自动出现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but crucial; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point. Post-training grows in importance.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽但至关重要；AGI 是平滑的指数曲线而非单一节点。后训练的重要性日益凸显。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; safety and capabilities intertwined. Open source is a red herring; focus on model quality.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；安全与能力相辅相成。开源是伪命题；应聚焦模型质量。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years. Economic diffusion lags.
dario.zh: 我们正接近指数增长的尾声；'天才之国'可能在 1-3 年内到来。经济扩散滞后。

dario.en: AI's greatest impact in biomedicine; enterprise data key. Hybrid reasoning models superior; governance harder than tech.
dario.zh: AI 最大影响在生物医学；企业数据是关键。混合推理模型更优；治理比技术更难。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应成为基本人权，借助自动评分与同伴互评的在线课程能在规模上实现精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，而强化学习与 AGI 对齐问题被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Electricity and chips bottleneck AI scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agentic workflows are here.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和芯片制约 AI 扩展，开放权重模型成为地缘软实力，智能体工作流已实际可用。

andrewng.en: AI skills are now essential for engineers; AGI is far off; top-down workflow redesign beats bottom-up adoption.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AI 技能成为工程师必备，AGI 遥不可及，自上而下的流程重构优于自下而上的采用。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; coding agents advance faster than expected.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI 为营销术语，扩展配方转向合成数据与强化学习，编码智能体进展超预期。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world for common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对常识至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient for AGI; world models from observation.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI；世界模型来自观察。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; JEPA architectures and open source are key; AGI gradual.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能；JEPA 架构和开源是关键；AGI 是渐进过程。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than cats; next AI needs non-generative world models; open source enables many.
lecun.zh: LLM 缺乏世界模型，不如猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要非生成式世界模型；开源赋能众多。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space; LLMs are dead end; objective-driven AI safer; open research essential.
lecun.zh: 世界模型在抽象空间预测；LLM 是死胡同；目标驱动 AI 更安全；开放研究至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Shift from engagement metrics to depth; AI as thought partner, preserving user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张从参与度指标转向深度，AI 应作为思想伙伴，保留用户自主性。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design unlocks latent functionality; launch early, cut features, rewrite fast.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，我强调智能体原生设计释放潜在功能，尽早发布、精简功能、快速重写。

mikekrieger.en: Small high-conviction teams beat larger ones; senior systems expertise still vital.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，我认为小而有信念的团队胜过大型团队，资深系统专长仍至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables overnight delegation; verification loops essential; models should push back.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 实现隔夜委派，验证循环必不可少，模型应能提出异议。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而可预测；Google 在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimal; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平能力；存在风险微乎其微；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key; AI companions can democratize expertise.
suleyman.zh: AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐是关键；AI 伴侣可以普及专业知识。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x in two years.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；推理成本两年内下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能临近；微软必须拥有前沿模型；白领任务被自动化，而非工作岗位。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; self-driving cars will dominate as insurance costs rise.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入；随着保险成本上升，自动驾驶汽车将占主导。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom foster clarity; self-care and mentorship are key after success.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊带来清晰；成功后的自我关怀和指导他人至关重要。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines products; small teams thrive on self-management; climate tech needs investment.
fadell.zh: 故事讲述定义产品；小团队靠自我管理；气候技术需要投资。

fadell.en: Start with painkiller not vitamin; v1 decisions are opinion-based; experts hinder innovation.
fadell.zh: 从止痛药而非维生素开始；初版决策基于观点；专家阻碍创新。

fadell.en: Resilience and adaptability are crucial; hybrid work future; invest in green despite downturns.
fadell.zh: 韧性和适应力至关重要；混合办公是未来；尽管经济低迷也要投资绿色。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; devices complement smartphones; OpenAI's economics worsen; Apple should redefine mobility.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；设备补充智能手机；OpenAI 经济恶化；苹果应重新定义出行。

fadell.en: Start from customer pain; singular vision; three generations; humans in loop to avoid tech debt.
fadell.zh: 从客户痛点出发；单一愿景；三代产品；人类参与避免技术债。

fadell.en: Innovation from going off script; fight habituation; AI wearables federated; near-death drives change.
fadell.zh: 创新来自打破常规；对抗习惯化；AI 可穿戴设备联邦化；濒死驱动变革。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器，以复利积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data; every company should have them to hill-climb on frontier models.
satya.zh: 私有评估可能是最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值；每家公司都应拥有它们，以便在前沿模型上爬山。

satya.en: Per-user pricing is an artifact of budget certainty; consumption pricing will grow as outcome-based models become preferred.
satya.zh: 按用户定价是预算确定性的产物；随着基于结果的模型受到青睐，消费定价将增长。

satya.en: The biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking from enterprises via AI training; security and containment are critical for agent deployment.
satya.zh: 最大的风险是企业隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；安全和遏制对于智能体部署至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI is best achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not by building firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10% via AI.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 的最佳实现方式是让公司能够爬山，而不是建立防火墙；通过 AI，全球 GDP 可能以 10% 的速度复利增长。

murati.en: Scaling laws and iterative deployment with public feedback are key to safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，强调缩放定律和通过公开反馈的迭代部署是实现安全与对齐的关键。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年，转向基于时间的交互模型，而非轮次式，以实现实时人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasize institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年，强调制度设计、透明度和制衡机制，而非个人品格。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible to align intent and values, not remove them.
murati.zh: 2026 年，主张尽可能让人类参与其中以对齐意图和价值观，而非移除人类。

murati.en: Durable progress over compressed timelines; agency to steer AI toward collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年，主张持久进步而非压缩时间线，并强调我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: train on more tokens, not just bigger models; data quality is critical.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，我认为缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：应训练更多词元而非仅扩大模型；数据质量至关重要。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x over three years; value accrues at application layer, not just foundation models.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，我强调算法效率三年可提升百倍，价值将更多体现在应用层而非仅基础模型。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，我主张将 AI 视为机遇而非风险，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观。

mensch.en: Pre-training hits saturation; differentiation shifts to domain-specific fine-tuning and vertical specialization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，我认为预训练趋于饱和，差异化转向领域微调与垂直专业化。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not destination; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，我强调 AGI 是方向而非终点，企业采用瓶颈在于组织变革而非模型智能。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not slowing; reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling still works, but post-training (RL, synthetic data) drives recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍有效，但后训练（强化学习、合成数据）推动近期进展；经济压力使焦点转向更小模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable hard problem solving, but models still need vast data and have jagged generalization.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据，且泛化能力参差不齐。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x; hardware democratizes single-GPU research.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，编码智能体将研究者效率提升 5-10 倍；硬件进步使单 GPU 研究普及化。

kaiser.en: Existential risk less pressing than near-term risks like system hacking; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，相比系统黑客等近期风险，存在性风险不那么紧迫；开源因主权原因持续存在。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，我认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，我指出自动形式化比证明更难，尤其是在没有解决方案的情况下正确形式化陈述极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，我强调形式化验证是为了扩展智慧，而非仅仅消除错误，它能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，我坚持认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法是必要的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，我指出即使有超人 AI 证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外拥有巨大潜力。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future lies in local computers and shared tools, not hyper-personalized software; scaffolding may fade as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为 AI 的未来在于本地计算机和共享工具，而非超个性化软件；随着模型改进，脚手架可能不再重要。

felixrieseberg.en: The main gap is people not realizing any problem can be given to AI; kids excel because they haven't learned limits.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出最大差距是人们不了解几乎所有问题都可以交给 AI；孩子因未学会设限而表现出色。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; interaction should be asynchronous.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，强调 AI 应处理繁琐后台任务，解放人类从事创造性工作；交互应异步进行。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended ones; debugging with Claude is better than correcting it.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，建议对明确任务用 Sonnet，对开放任务用 Opus；与 Claude 一起调试优于直接修正。

felixrieseberg.en: Invest in capabilities and safety; AI tools will impact junior employees, so society must discuss labor changes.
felixrieseberg.zh: 始终强调投资于能力和安全；AI 工具将影响初级员工，社会需讨论劳动力变化。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic viability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本促使就业回流；将 AGI 定义为智能体无需人类干预即可持续盈利运行。

danshipper.en: Everyone will delegate to agents; human oversight remains essential; SaaS grows with agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预测人人拥有智能体，但人类监督仍关键；SaaS 因智能体而增长而非消亡。

danshipper.en: GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work replace CLIs as primary work surfaces.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面将取代命令行成为主要工作界面。

danshipper.en: One company-wide super agent beats personal agents; SaaS should not embed AI.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，主张公司采用统一超级智能体而非个人智能体；SaaS 不应内嵌 AI，用户自带 AI。

danshipper.en: Benchmarks overestimate AI autonomy; real tasks need human framing; AI writing often superior internally.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，指出基准测试高估 AI 自主性，实际任务需人类设定框架；内部文档 AI 写作常优于人类。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics: memory bandwidth, not compute, dominates cost; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理经济学：内存带宽而非算力主导成本；批大小权衡延迟与成本。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制。

reinerpope.en: AI chips: multiply-accumulate is fundamental; systolic arrays reduce data movement; low precision yields quadratic gains.
reinerpope.zh: AI 芯片：乘加运算是基础；脉动阵列减少数据移动；低精度带来二次方收益。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; GPUs are many tiny TPUs tiled together.
reinerpope.zh: 数据移动在芯片内部也主导算力；GPU 是许多小 TPU 拼接而成。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers spend less time mocking up and must help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已死；设计师花在模拟上的时间减少，必须帮助工程师执行。

jennywen.en: Design vision horizon shrinks from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; speed and trust via rapid iteration.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景的视野从 2-5 年缩短到 3-6 个月；通过快速迭代建立信任。

jennywen.en: AI improves taste but humans decide what matters; designers should be block-shaped generalists.
jennywen.zh: AI 提升品味但人类决定什么重要；设计师应成为块状通才。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped, deep T specialist, cracked new grad; judgment and vision key.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状、深 T 专家、破解的新毕业生；判断力和愿景是关键。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before new tools; center users not hype.
jennywen.zh: 设计师控制 AI 采用；新工具等 6 个月再采用；以用户为中心而非炒作。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要，安全是系统级属性。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% of gains; RL with verifiable rewards boosts reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年：后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT 贡献 90%的提升；基于可验证奖励的强化学习增强推理能力。

lambert.en: RLVR is a key post-training breakthrough; open models need better tool-use training; hybrid reasoning may be temporary.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 是后训练的关键突破；开放模型需加强工具使用训练；混合推理模型可能只是过渡。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：预训练缩放定律仍成立，但易得收益已尽；提升转向后训练和推理时扩展。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade; Chinese labs excel in engineering, but US-China gap may widen.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：开放模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究；中国实验室擅长工程，但中美差距可能拉大。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning surpasses hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；现代工具使其可解释，这与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯处缓慢前行。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, human interaction, and introspection in driving models.
kendall.zh: 语言集成改善了驾驶模型的表示、人机交互和内省能力。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling generalizable AI requires massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶本质上是 AI 问题；扩展通用 AI 需要海量数据、算力和世界模型。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键；消费车辆将超越机器人出租车。

karpathy.en: Initially saw neural nets as simple math with emergent behaviors; Transformers as general-purpose differentiable computers; vision-only driving.
karpathy.zh: 最初将神经网络视为具有涌现行为的简单数学表达；Transformer 是通用可微计算机；自动驾驶仅依赖视觉。

karpathy.en: Emphasized synthetic data's future but warned of model collapse; Tesla's end-to-end approach; small cognitive core via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 强调合成数据的未来但警告模型崩溃；特斯拉端到端方法；通过蒸馏实现小认知核心。

karpathy.en: Introduced Software 3.0 paradigm; LLMs as operating systems; vibe coding; decade of agents with human oversight.
karpathy.zh: 提出软件 3.0 范式；LLM 作为操作系统；氛围编码；智能体十年需人类监督。

karpathy.en: Called LLMs 'ghosts' not animals; criticized RL and synthetic data; advocated for small cognitive core stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 称 LLM 为“鬼魂”而非动物；批评强化学习和合成数据；主张剥离记忆的小认知核心。

karpathy.en: Stopped typing code, delegates to agents; agentic engineering; jagged intelligence persists; understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 停止手写代码，委托给智能体；智能体工程；智能的锯齿状持续；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 画布上的直接操作优于提示调整；设计成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: AI won't replace jobs; human taste and craft remain critical for final output, despite role merging talk.
dylanfield.zh: AI 不会取代工作；人类品味和工艺对最终输出仍然至关重要，尽管有角色融合的说法。

dylanfield.en: The industry is at the start of AI integration; divergence-convergence loops are key for creativity.
dylanfield.zh: 行业处于 AI 整合的起点；发散-收敛循环是创造力的关键。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks.
pachocki.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是一系列里程碑，而非单一事件；迭代部署有助于在实际应用中学习和降低风险。

pachocki.en: Scaling reasoning models will accelerate AI progress; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag.
pachocki.zh: 扩展推理模型将加速 AI 进展；能力测量成为瓶颈，因为基准测试滞后。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices for continual learning.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；仅强化学习就足以实现持续学习。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool, providing interpretability; hiding it in products is crucial.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是对齐的关键工具，提供可解释性；在产品中隐藏它至关重要。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

turley.en: The model is the product; iterate like software, shipping daily to learn from real users.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样迭代，每日发布以从真实用户中学习。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来；它像 MS-DOS，AI 应生成自己的界面。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发快速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention, signaling durable value; growth from friction removal and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存，表明持久价值；增长来自消除摩擦和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型无缝产品化。

kohli.en: AI in science should tackle root-node problems for broad impact, not narrow applications.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 在科学中应解决根节点问题以产生广泛影响，而非狭窄应用。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为大语言模型的幻觉在结合真值检测器后，可用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我认为大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我认为结合强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我认为可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is hard. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿提出 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并不解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; controlling AI is dangerous. We should let them be free like children.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，萨顿主张 AI 应去中心化、无需许可地发展，控制 AI 是危险的，应像对待孩子一样给予自由。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; LLMs lack world models and true goals.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，萨顿强调强化学习是智能的核心，大语言模型缺乏世界模型和真实目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，萨顿提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models is another.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，萨顿认为学习有利于学习的表征是首要开放问题，基于学习模型的规划是另一个关键问题。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. LLMs alone may not reach AGI; new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年底，我认为 AGI 至少还需十年以上，因为从 80%到 99.9%的性能提升极其困难。仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现 AGI，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and can be gamed; real progress should be measured through deep human evaluations. Optimizing for engagement leads to 'slop'.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年底，我强调像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被钻空子，真正的进展应通过深度人工评估来衡量。为参与度优化会导致模型输出“垃圾内容”。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from. This idea persists into 2026.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 年底到 2026 年初，我持续认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。这一观点在 2026 年依然成立。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI tools can hallucinate; human judgment is critical. Doctors using AI may underperform AI alone due to anchoring and sycophancy.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年初，在医学领域，我认为 AI 工具可能产生幻觉，人类判断至关重要。医生使用 AI 时可能因锚定效应和谄媚行为而表现不如单独使用 AI。

edwinchen.en: Quality in data creation requires taste, sophistication, and creativity beyond credentials. Different frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AIs.
edwinchen.zh: 始终，我坚持数据创建的质量需要品味、成熟度和创造力，而不仅仅是资历。不同前沿实验室的目标函数不同，塑造了多样化的 AI。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, and learning from video is promising for agents.
nando.zh: AI 应作为增强人类能力的工具，从视频中学习对智能体很有前景。

nando.en: Generalist agents tokenizing all inputs are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 将一切输入 token 化的通才智能体是迈向 AGI 的一步。

nando.en: AI safety is the biggest challenge; we lack solutions yet.
nando.zh: AI 安全是最大挑战，我们尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs in AI, with unique advantages and early influence.
nando.zh: 非洲在 AI 领域实现跨越式发展，具有独特优势和早期影响。

nando.en: Emphasizes human skills, diversity, and collaboration in AI research.
nando.zh: 始终强调 AI 研究中的人类技能、多样性与合作。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, and fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough, enabling expert-level performance and new capabilities.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，能实现专家级表现并习得新能力。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL is likely sufficient for AGI; coding is the leading indicator and will accelerate AI research.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练加强化学习足以实现 AGI；编程是领先指标，将加速 AI 研究。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence (e.g., 30 hours) expands capabilities; progress is exponential.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出强化学习是新的扩展轴，更长的智能体连贯性（如 30 小时）扩展能力，进展是指数级的。

sholto.en: Capability overhang is massive; managing agent teams and compute supply matter more than raw intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩严重，管理智能体团队和算力供应比原始智能更重要。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better algorithms and data can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的算法和数据，较小的模型也能超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我逐渐强调数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是在插值人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning requires careful engineering; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我认为强化学习需要精细工程；RLVR 可能降低 pass@k，即使 best-of-n 有所提升。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; pluralistic alignment respects diverse values.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张通过多样化合成数据使小语言模型强大；多元对齐尊重不同价值观。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我提出在预训练阶段引入强化学习，通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; quality is like debt, paid iteratively.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈，通过引导工程师和统一问题来协作；质量如同债务，需迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: AI is a creative partner; design tools' future is interoperable with code as source of truth; legacy tools are outdated.
nadchishtie.zh: AI 是创意伙伴；设计工具的未来是互操作，以代码为源；传统工具已过时。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process.
nadchishtie.zh: 用 AI 端到端执行的通才最有价值；作品集应展示工艺与意图，而非过程。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads; IC tracks limit growth; generalists win.
nadchishtie.zh: 小而精的设计师与工程师团队优于跨职能大组；IC 轨道限制成长；通才胜出。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; ignoring it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为常态；忽视它如同早期忽视互联网。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict AI progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我强调缩放定律预测 AI 进步，并认为测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练缩放，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我提出自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; taste and logic design become more valuable.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我认为编程将从代码转向意图指定，品味和逻辑设计比谨慎更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我强调定制模型对产品质量至关重要，Cursor 中每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: AI shift more consequential than internet, unfolding over decades; incumbents may struggle.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我指出 AI 变革比互联网影响更大，将持续数十年，现有巨头可能难以适应。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年：设计师应会编码以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年：初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南是动态平台，而非僵化规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning, and invest in brand early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：设计是战略武器；创始人需阐明其制胜作用，并尽早投资品牌以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow and collaborate.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权与自主权，以促进成长与协作。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic feedback and gut decisions over data-driven processes in fast startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：避免结构化设计评审；在快速初创中，偏好有机反馈与直觉决策，而非数据驱动流程。

scottwu.en: AI will increase, not decrease, the number of programmers due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from brick layers to architects.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 会因杰文斯悖论增加而非减少程序员数量；工程师角色从砌砖工转向架构师。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; focus on teaching real-world engineering idiosyncrasies, not model capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，他提出基础智能已足够，重点应放在教授真实世界的工程特性，而非模型能力。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进而非突发的；即使冻结模型，产品创新仍可推进十年。

scottwu.en: Enterprise AI agents require trust and permissions, not full autonomy; both synchronous and asynchronous experiences matter.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他指出企业 AI 智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；同步与异步体验都重要。

scottwu.en: All layers of AI stack (datacenter, labs, applications) will thrive, not just one; value accrues with differentiation.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他认为 AI 栈的所有层（数据中心、实验室、应用）都会繁荣，价值源于差异化。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年中，AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模云厂商主导；初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Programming evolves to AI-generated code, prioritizing verifiability; coding agents need root-cause fixes for productivity.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年中，编程转向 AI 生成代码，强调可验证性；编码智能体需根因分析才能提升生产力。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as vital as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business results.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，客户体验 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使软件价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents turn developers into operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体将开发者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents compared to agents, not humans; incumbents struggle with AI-native models; generalists outperform specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，AI 智能体将与其他智能体比较而非人类；现有企业难以转向 AI 原生模式；通才胜过专才。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; alignment and robustness are key; empirical research is under-explored.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全至关重要，对齐和鲁棒性是关键；实证研究尚待充分探索。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability; alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient; external oversight and regulation necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，指出 OpenAI 安全文化退化，后训练不足以解决对齐，需外部监督和监管。

shazeer.en: Next-token prediction is an AI-complete problem; scaling with compute and data makes models smarter, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 下一个词预测是一个 AI 完备问题；通过算力和数据扩展让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期机会；模块化稀疏架构实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非仅被动数据；模块化组件的持续学习可取代重新训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 测试时算力扩展推动进步，但单独无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will be enormous. Coding is underhyped as it enables AI self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: AGI 被低估；其经济影响将巨大。编码也被低估，因为它能实现 AI 自我加速。
